jobs.title: Python AI Engineer
jobs.description: Summary: Soliton is a high-technology software company working with global customers across Semiconductor, Medical, Automotive, Industry 4.0, and High-Tech domains. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent applications leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern AI engineering practices. Position Overview: The Applied AI Engineer is responsible for building AI-driven applications by integrating Generative AI models, data pipelines, and inference systems into production-ready solutions. This role involves hands-on development with Python and AI frameworks, designing RAG-based systems, optimizing model performance, and ensuring responsible AI deployment through guardrails and observability. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize Generative AI applications using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI. Build AI solutions using LLM frameworks like LlamaIndex and LangChain. Implement containerized deployments using Docker. Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for improved information retrieval. Work with self-hosted and cloud-based vector databases for efficient search and retrieval. Design and manage knowledge graphs and graph-based RAG systems. Implement re-ranking models and retrieval optimization techniques. Apply prompt engineering and context engineering to enhance model performance. Establish guardrails to ensure safe, ethical, and compliant AI deployments. Build data preprocessing and transformation pipelines for structured and unstructured data. Perform inference using offline LLMs via platforms like Ollama or Hugging Face (Llama, Mistral). Integrate online LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or GCP for real-time inference. Monitor AI workflows using observability tools like MLflow or Arize Phoenix. Evaluate model performance using frameworks such as TruLens or custom-built evaluation systems. Continuously improve AI systems based on evaluation insights, metrics, and user feedback. Skills for a Generative AI Engineer: Experience building Generative AI applications using Python and FastAPI. Hands-on knowledge of LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. Ability to work with unstructured data (PDFs, documents, chunking, search) and structured data. Experience designing RAG-based systems, including prompt engineering and retrieval optimization. Familiarity with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate) and search solutions. Exposure to AI agents, workflows, and basic orchestration concepts. Experience using cloud platforms like Azure or AWS. Working knowledge of online and offline LLMs (OpenAI, Llama, Mistral). Understanding of AI evaluation, monitoring, and observability concepts. Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI applications. Good to Have: Experience with MCP clients and servers. Knowledge of multimodal LLMs for image and voice processing. Knowledge of deploying applications in cloud or on-prem infrastructure. Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and data preparation for fine-tuning. Qualifications: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in AI/ML engineering and related technologies. 3+ years of experience building applications using Python and asynchronous programming. Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Benefits : We want every Soliton member to grow to their highest potential. Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what its like to work at Soliton. Careers | Soliton Technologies Solitons choose their work hours as long as they take into account the requirements of the job. We take special care to support mothers to excel at work while they handle their responsibilities at home. At Soliton, we believe that every team member contributes to our success and revenue, directly or indirectly. To recognize this, we share a portion of our profits with all Solitons. Starting from your second year with us, youll be eligible to receive a share of the companys profits. Health insurance for employees and families, gym and cycle allowance – your health is a priority! About Soliton : Soliton Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a high-technology software company headquartered in Bangalore, India. Soliton works with global companies, from start-ups to Fortune 500, across industries including Semiconductors, Medical Devices, Automotive, Industry 4.0, and Robotics to help them increase their competitiveness and release great products through Software Engineering Services. Since 1997, we have been growing over 25% annually because we especially focus on raising our standards constantly, to deliver an excellent experience to both our customers and our employees. Soliton Technologies is a certified Great Place to Work® in the Mid-Sized Organizations Category, recognized and issued by the Great Place to Work® Institute. This certification is a testament to our focus on our values of Respect, Integrity, Excellence and Innovation. With a team of over 400 employees across the world, we forge ahead as engineers working to our heart’s content, moving humanity forward. Additional Details : Work Location (Bangalore/Coimbatore) : This role will require working from the office (WFO) for the first 12 months. Based on individual performance and business requirements, a remote or hybrid work option may be considered after one year. For more information, visit https://www.solitontech.com/ and do read the Impact Report to get a glimpse of the first 25 years of our truly meaningful journey. 3-5 Yrs generative ai, Python, Langchain, llm, Artificial Intelligence

jobs.title: Substation Automation Engineer / Protection Engineer
jobs.description: Greeting from RecruitGuruz Staffing Solutions! We are currently looking for Substation Automation / Protection Engineer with US based Solar MNC. Our client accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. Our client has fully commoditized renewable energy project development-as-a-service (DaaS), including 100% internal systems engineering and Construction-as-a-Service (CaaS). Our client support developers, builders, land-owners and financers through any portion of project execution, including turnkey delivery of built assets. Location: Ahmedabad, Noida, Chennai Experience: 5-8 Years Qualification: BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech - Electrical or Energy or related Position Summary: Seeking an experienced Substation Automation / Protection Engineer to lead protection, control, relay coordination, SCADA, and automation design for US utility-scale projects, including Solar PV, BESS, and Natural Gas Power Plants. Requires hands-on US utility project experience, expertise in SEL relays and AcSELerator tools, protection studies, IEC 61850, IEEE standards, NERC CIP and field commissioning. Core Responsibilities Protection Philosophy & Design : Develop and own the protection philosophy of the substation for transmission, distribution, generator, transformer, bus, feeder, capacitor bank and line protection applications. Prepare relay one-line diagrams, AC/DC schematics, wiring diagrams, communication architectures and protection settings. Design, configure, test, and commission substation protection, automation, SCADA, and communication systems for Solar PV, BESS, Natural Gas Generation Facilities, collector substations, switching stations and transmission interconnections (12 kV through 500 kV). Protection Studies Short Circuit & Relay Coordination: Perform short-circuit studies and analysis to establish fault levels, verify equipment duty, and provide inputs for relay settings. Perform relay coordination studies and complete relay coordination calculations to ensure selective, secure, and dependable protection. Carry out arc-flash assessments (IEEE 1584), breaker-failure schemes, synch-check applications, transfer trip schemes, remedial action schemes (RAS) and system stability-related protection reviews Relay Configuration & Integration: Select, configure, and program protective relays, RTACs, HMIs, and gateways, with expert-level knowledge of SEL relays and RTACs. Use the SEL AcSELerator tool suite to develop settings and logic, and integrate SEL devices into the wider substation automation and SCADA system. Work with other utility-grade equipment including GE Vernova, Siemens, Schneider Electric, ABB/Hitachi Energy, and Beckwith. Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems. Substation Automation, SCADA & Communications: Implement IEC 61850 for substation automation and protection. Design and configure SCADA systems using DNP3, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 61850, Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA and other utility communication protocols. Develop SCADA point lists, communication maps, telemetry databases, ICCP interfaces, alarm management philosophies and historian integration for generation and utility interconnection projects. Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation and field implementation. Cybersecurity & Compliance: Apply cybersecurity and NERC CIP hardware and software requirements and implement these standards in real-world designs. Support utility interconnection requirements and compliance with ISO/RTO standards including CAISO, MISO, PJM, ERCOT, SPP, NYISO and ISO-NE. Coordination & Technical Support Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, utilities and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices. Support testing, laboratory validation, and field commissioning of protection and automation systems. Technical Skills and Experience Software Proficiency: SEL AcSELerator suite QuickSet, Architect, RTAC, SynchroWAVe and Grid Configurator, with a working knowledge of how SEL devices are integrated into the automation system Protection study software such as ETAP, ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, CYME, or SKM PowerTools Standards & Protocols: IEEE standards including IEEE 1547, IEEE C37 series, IEEE 1584, IEEE 1815 (DNP3) and IEEE 2030 IEC 61850, NERC CIP and cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology (OT) environments, including secure communications and system hardening SCADA protocols: DNP3, IEC 60870-5-101/104, Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA Power Generation Systems: Understanding of protection and automation requirements for utility-scale Solar PV, standalone BESS, Natural Gas Power Plants, and high-voltage substations. Knowledge of US utility interconnection practices and ISO/RTO requirements. If you are interested, please apply or send your cv on kirti.patel@recruitguruz.com Regards, Kirti Patel 5-9 Yrs Substation Automation, Substation Automation Protection, Protection Philosophy & Design, Protective Relay Configuration, Relay Coordination, Short Circuit, Protection Studies, Substation Protection & Control

jobs.title: .Net Data Engineer
jobs.description: .NET Data Engineer Job Description Role Overview The .NET Data Engineer will own the data backbone of an AI-driven submission management and Reserving platform for an insurance company . The .NET data engineer will be responsible for integrating, transforming, and consolidating data from various structured and unstructured sources into formats suitable for analytics and reporting. They design and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and high-performance data stores, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and reliability according to business requirements The candidate must be working primarily in C#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure, with React on the front end, with preference for candidates who understand insurance and reserving concepts. Must-Have Skills Data Import, ETL & SQL Design repeatable processes to import data from CSV files and external APIs into SQL Server tables, then transform and cleanse it into production tables. Write and maintain SQL stored procedures (SPs) for data migration and transformation, using parameters and variables so the same procedure can be reused across data sources, environments, or business units (LOBs). ¢ Ensure stored procedures and .NET import tools are safely re-runnable (idempotent) handling duplicates, missing data, and partial failures without corrupting data. API & Third-Party Integrations ¢ Build and maintain .NET services that integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., Salesforce) for data enrichment and synchronization. ¢ Handle authentication flows (OAuth client credentials, Bearer tokens) and design request/response models that map cleanly to C# classes. .NET Application Development ¢ Design and build .NET / C# applications Azure Functions (isolated worker model) and console utilities that call external APIs, process data in bulk, and write results to SQL Server. ¢ Use dependency injection, configuration binding (appsettings.json, User Secrets, Azure App Configuration, Key Vault), and structured logging as standard patterns across all new services. ¢ Implement asynchronous, concurrent processing (async/await, SemaphoreSlim-based bounded concurrency) to handle bulk data volumes efficiently without overwhelming downstream APIs. ¢ Build resilient HTTP client code: authentication (OAuth/Bearer tokens), retry logic with backoff for transient failures, and proper error handling so a single bad record does not break an entire batch run. ¢ Work with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries for reading and writing application data in SQL Server. ¢ Write and maintain unit and integration tests for data-processing logic. React Front End ¢ Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end best practices, with the ability to build responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces. ¢ Develop and maintain web applications using React.js; build reusable UI components and front-end libraries for future use. ¢ Collaborate with backend developers to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions. Data Quality, DevOps & Documentation ¢ Validate data accuracy after each import/migration run (row counts, key-field checks, spot-checks against source data). ¢ Use Git for version control (branching, pull requests) and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD (build, test, multi-environment deployment). ¢ Document data flows, mapping logic, and known data quality issues for the rest of the team. Reporting & KPIs ¢ Build and maintain KPI queries/views and reporting datasets to support business and operational dashboards. ¢ Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable, well-documented SQL views or stored procedures. Good-to-Have Skills Insurance Domain Knowledge ¢ Familiarity with commercial insurance and underwriting concepts and the submission lifecycle (intake, triage, clearance, referral, quote). ¢ Understanding of common insurance data structures and documents, such as ACORD forms, loss runs, and statements of value (SOVs). ¢ Exposure to broker, policy, and submission data models. 10-14 Yrs Data Pipeline, .NET, Data Warehousing, ETL, Python, Pyspark, Microsoft Azure, AWS

Work with the Support team to investigate and resolve complex, full-stack issues raised by users and provide quick workarounds for significant system errors. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior - where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system - acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation - that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows. Responsibilities Test strategy and hands-on testing Define and own the products test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing. Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation. Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions. Automated coverage Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing. Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas. Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable. Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agents remote sessions on user machines. Release confidence and test infrastructure Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence. Introduce failure-injection scenarios - service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits - to prove the product degrades gracefully. Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy. Collaboration and quality leadership Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices. Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting. What we value Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms.
